scope: Hill ground and grass URP light/occlusion integration
authority: Current saved Unity shader sources; URP 17.6.0 installed source API. Historical captures are only contextual; new native qualification is pending.
confirmedSourceDefects: Both custom shaders ignored additional lights and SSAO although the saved PC renderer enables them.
Grass forced 50 percent of sun light through even at complete shadow attenuation.
Grass had no depth prepass so SSAO/depth consumers could not represent its blade cutouts.
Ground borrowed URP Lit DepthOnly with a different UnityPerMaterial buffer.
The original GetMainLight(shadowCoord) overload did not include URP distance-faded main-light shadows.
changes: Per-pixel additional light loop, local shadow and cookie variants, and correct main-light shadow fade.
Separate URP screen-space indirect and direct occlusion factors.
Grass cutout silhouette and wind deformation shared by color, depth and depth-normal passes.
Ground-specific DepthOnly sharing its forward material layout.
preserved: Grass blade silhouettes and authored broad directional response
Scene, geometry, colliders, transforms, materials, routes
Linux OpenGL graphics API and URP pipeline
